Method of Attack: Illegally streaming MLB, NBA, NFL, and NHL games via the web
Hacking into sports leagues' customer accounts
Operating a live streaming website for profit with subscription fees
Exploiting a flaw in a third-party service's access token system to authenticate as legit users
Attempting to extort MLB by threatening to publish platform access vulnerabilities
Discoverer: U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York
Attack Vector: Exploiting third-party service access token flaw
Indicators of Compromise: Redirects visitors to legal channels after seizure by ACE (Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment)
